name: @unicitylabs/native-bridge-plugin
build: npm install --ignore-scripts (repo root, with its vendored SDK and bridge-core tarballs)
npm run build (in packages/native-bridge-plugin: tsc -p tsconfig.json -> lib/)

package.json: drop the file: dependencies on @unicitylabs/bridge-core and @unicitylabs/state-transition-sdk and declare both as peerDependencies "*" (written with JSON.stringify(p, null, 2), no trailing newline), so the wallet's own vendored SDK and bridge-core are used
verified: NB2 v1.1 authenticated UTB tip, canonical child-bound Mint receipts, and durable certification. The SDK and bridge-core tarballs match the demo copies byte for byte.
notes: native-bridge-plugins #94 (merged as b752c2a1): needs-archive only on a node's own pruned answer, never after a count of reads; a payout not certified yet stays pending; needs-archive names the missing component. Ships with the generation whose manifest names this commit.

toolchain.note: npm pack output is gzip-dependent: this toolchain reproduces sha256; node 22 (npm 10.9, zlib 1.3.1) packs the same tar into a different gzip. tarSha256 (the gunzipped tarball) is toolchain-independent.
